title: knautia arvensis subsp. numidica
intro: Knautia arvensis subsp. numidica, commonly known as the Numidian Knotweed, is a plant species within the Veronicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of Knautia arvensis subsp. numidica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
